value.rationale: The two criteria capture different established fairness priorities: lexicographic concentration of high-ranked partners versus balance of aggregate rank burden across the two sides. Their sharp first conflict and complete optimum-set relation census provide a natural small-market benchmark with multiple qualitatively distinct conflict modes.
